fail_closed_rules: Housing need is an unconstrained minimum assessment, not an adopted housing requirement, site allocation or planning permission.
A five-year housing land supply position is authority- and base-date-specific; failure to demonstrate supply affects policy but does not grant parcel permission.
Housing Delivery Test results are authority-level, period-specific measurements; historical results must not replace the latest applicable result or recalculation.
HELAA/SHLAA inclusion, call-for-sites submission or site scoring is evidence work, not an allocation, permission or Future Growth business score.
Suitability, availability, achievability, deliverability and developability are distinct evidence judgements and do not prove title, funding, infrastructure or build-out.
A draft allocation is not adopted policy; an adopted allocation is still not planning permission and does not resolve all site-specific constraints.
During the 2026 transition, legacy and new local-plan process events, consultations and gateways must not be merged without identifying the applicable statutory route.
Gateway 1, 2 or 3 progress, examination submission, soundness findings, modifications and adoption are different procedural states and must remain separate.
Plan timetables contain anticipated and actual dates; an anticipated milestone is not evidence that the event occurred.
Local-plan, boundary and document aggregations created by MHCLG require provenance/date checks and must not override authoritative operative plan evidence.
A zero-record or no-attempt Planning Data dataset is NO_DATA only and never proves absence of a plan, policy, allocation or constraint.
Brownfield register inclusion is not permission, guaranteed deliverability or proof that contamination and other constraints are absent.
Experimental brownfield-site geometry must not replace authoritative brownfield records or exact current site-plan geometry.
Brownfield dwelling capacity and planning-permission-status fields are dated register attributes and must be checked against current permissions, amendments and completions.
Ownership-status categories are not legal-title or implementable-control evidence.
National housing supply, dwelling-stock and building-control statistics are contextual aggregates and must not be downscaled into parcel development probability.
Published evidence, baselining, vision, consultation and requirement-to-assist material can inform plan-making but is not automatically operative development-plan policy.
Local housing requirement, local housing need, five-year supply, Housing Delivery Test and site capacity are different measures and must never be collapsed into one number.
Coverage counts, collector dates and quality labels describe dataset provenance/freshness, not complete national parcel coverage.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score or business row may be promoted while RECOVERY_PARKED persists, predecessor is incomplete and business execution is forbidden.
